summary.en: iFLYTEK's Spark model platform for Chinese-first LLM and multimodal capabilities.
summary.zh: 讯飞星火面向中文场景，提供大模型与多模态能力，支持开发者通过开放平台接入。

title.en: iFLYTEK Spark API Key - Official Access | Get Model Key
title.zh: 讯飞星火 API Key - 官方入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get the official iFLYTEK Spark API key entry and docs for developer access.
description.zh: 查看讯飞星火官方 API Key 申请入口与开发文档，快速完成接入。

title.zh: 星火新用户 Token 福利

benefit.en: New users can usually get around 5M tokens; real-name verification is often required (subject to official policy).
benefit.zh: 新用户通常可获得约 500 万 Token；一般需要完成实名（具体以官方规则为准）。

notes.en: Strong Chinese context handling, making it suitable for content creation and complex multi-turn conversations.
notes.zh: 中文语义理解和上下文把握能力强，适合内容创作与复杂多轮对话。

en: iFLYTEK Spark (讯飞星火) is a China-focused LLM and multimodal platform strong in Chinese language tasks.
Developers obtain app credentials through the Xfyun open platform console (console.xfyun.cn) rather than third-party resellers.
zh: 讯飞星火面向中文场景，提供大模型与多模态能力，擅长中文理解与生成任务。
开发者应在讯飞开放平台控制台（console.xfyun.cn）申请应用凭证，勿经第三方倒卖渠道。

en: Open the official Xfyun console entry listed for Spark and register or sign in.
Create or select an application and enable the Spark-related services you need.
Copy the AppID / APIKey / APISecret (or current credential fields) shown in the console.
Follow https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/ for signing rules, endpoints, and sample code.
zh: 打开本站收录的讯飞星火控制台入口并注册/登录。
创建或选择应用，开通所需的星火相关服务。
复制控制台展示的 AppID、APIKey、APISecret（或以当前页面字段为准）。
按 https://www.xfyun.cn/doc/spark/ 完成鉴权签名、接口地址与示例对接。

question.en: Who is Spark best suited for?

answer.en: Teams building Chinese-first products—content, dialogue, and multimodal apps—often evaluate Spark on the open platform.
answer.zh: 做中文优先的内容、对话与多模态应用的团队，常在开放平台上评估星火。

answer.en: Promotions can change. Check the official console policy; any trial notes on this site are informational only.
answer.zh: 活动会调整。请以官方控制台规则为准；本站如有试用说明仅作信息提示。
